en.text: Checking 25 different rooms gives more cases than checking one room 25 times.

qb:selection-bias.label: Selection bias

example.en: Checking only rooms already known to contain treasure biases a claim about all rooms.

en.text: A selection method that systematically favours some cases, so the sample may misrepresent the target group.

en.text: Checking only rooms already known to contain treasure biases a claim about all rooms.

definition.en: A selection method that systematically favours some cases, making the sample unrepresentative of the intended group. A larger biased sample can still mislead.
definition.ms: Kaedah pemilihan yang cenderung secara sistematik kepada kes tertentu sehingga sampel tidak mewakili kumpulan sasaran. Sampel berat sebelah yang lebih besar masih boleh mengelirukan.

example.en: Choosing only cards already known to be purple gives biased evidence for a claim that all 31 example cards are purple.
example.ms: Memilih hanya kad yang sudah diketahui ungu menghasilkan bukti berat sebelah bagi dakwaan bahawa semua 31 kad contoh ungu.

en.text: A selection method that systematically favours some cases, making the sample unrepresentative of the intended group. A larger biased sample can still mislead.

qb:observation.label: Observation
qb:observation.definition: Something actually checked or recorded, rather than guessed about an untested case.
qb:observation.definition_ms: Perkara yang benar-benar diperiksa atau direkodkan.

example.en: 'The visited room contained a chest' records an observation.

en.text: Something actually checked or recorded, rather than guessed about an untested case.

ms.text: Perkara yang benar-benar diperiksa atau direkodkan.

en.text: 'The visited room contained a chest' records an observation.

definition.en: A result actually checked or recorded. Separate what was observed from guesses about cases not yet checked.

example.en: “I inspected example card t41 and saw a purple mark” is an observation about t41.
example.ms: “Saya memeriksa kad contoh t41 dan melihat tanda ungu” ialah pemerhatian tentang t41.

en.text: A result actually checked or recorded. Separate what was observed from guesses about cases not yet checked.

example.ms: “Kad contoh t55 yang belum diperiksa akan berwarna ungu” ialah ramalan, bukan pemerhatian tentang t55.

en.text: An upgraded label does not let you assume any unlisted card is in the upgraded set.

definition.en: A label identifying the listed improved items. For a set question, membership comes only from the stated IDs or condition; no damage bonus, cost change or extra member is assumed.
definition.ms: Label yang mengenal pasti item ditambah baik yang disenaraikan. Dalam soalan set, keahlian hanya mengikut ID atau syarat yang diberi; jangan andaikan bonus serangan, perubahan kos atau ahli tambahan.

example.en: If an example gives the upgraded set G = {t71,t74}, t71 is in G and t72 is outside G unless more information is supplied.
example.ms: Jika contoh memberi set ditambah baik G = {t71,t74}, t71 berada dalam G dan t72 di luar G kecuali maklumat tambahan diberi.
